items.a: Consultify is an AI-powered strategic consulting platform that helps industrial organizations navigate digital transformation. It combines artificial intelligence with human governance to deliver actionable roadmaps, not just reports.

items.q: How is this different from traditional consulting?
items.a: Traditional consulting delivers PowerPoint decks. Consultify delivers a living system. Our AI continuously analyzes your context, generates initiatives, and tracks execution. You get real-time strategic guidance, not a one-time report that sits on a shelf.

Absolutely. We are GDPR compliant with EU data residency. All data is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3). We never train AI models on your proprietary data. Enterprise customers can use their own API keys (BYOK).

items.q: Do I need technical expertise to use it?
items.a: No. Consultify is designed for business leaders, not IT specialists. The interface is intuitive, and our AI guides you through every step. We also offer onboarding support and training for your team.

items.q: Can I try before I buy?
items.a: Yes! We offer a 7-day free trial with full access to all features. No credit card required. You can also request a personalized demo with our team to see the platform in action with your specific use case.

We specialize in manufacturing and industrial sectors, including automotive, aerospace, electronics, food & beverage, and heavy industry. Our assessment frameworks are tailored to Industry 4.0 transformation challenges.

0.question: How do I earn commissions as a partner?
0.answer: You earn commissions by referring new clients to Consultify. When a client signs up using your unique referral code or link and becomes a paying customer, you receive a percentage of their subscription fee. Discount rates range from 10% to 14% depending on your partner tier.

1.question: When and how do I get paid?
1.answer: Commissions are paid monthly via bank transfer or PayPal, once you reach the €100 minimum threshold. Payments are processed on the 15th of each month for the previous month's approved commissions. You can track all earnings in real-time through your Partner Dashboard.

2.question: What support do I get as a partner?
2.answer: All partners receive access to Partner Academy training, marketing materials, and our partner community. Bronze tier and above get priority support and dedicated training. Gold and Platinum partners receive a dedicated Partner Manager, co-marketing opportunities, and early access to new features.

3.question: How long does it take to become certified?
3.answer: The Platform Fundamentals certification takes about 45 minutes to complete. Advanced certifications like DRD Framework take 2-3 hours. All certifications are self-paced, so you can complete them whenever it's convenient for you.

4.question: Can I refer clients from any country?
4.answer: Yes! Consultify operates globally, and you can refer clients from any country. Your Partner Directory listing can highlight your regional expertise, helping local clients find you. Commission payments can be made in EUR, USD, or GBP.

5.question: What happens if a referred client cancels?
5.answer: If a referred client cancels within the first 30 days (cooling-off period), the commission for that client is adjusted. After 30 days, you keep all earned commissions even if the client later cancels. We believe in fair, transparent commission structures.

stylePresets.concise: Respond briefly and directly, using as few words as possible. Focus on the core point without elaboration or follow-up questions.
stylePresets.executive: Respond like a senior consulting partner. Start with the recommendation, then 3-5 bullets with rationale. Add risks and next steps. Skip introductions.
stylePresets.analyst: Respond like a data analyst. Use tables, metrics, and benchmarks. Cite sources and confidence intervals. Structure data for easy further analysis.
stylePresets.formal: Use a formal, professional tone. Write clear, well-structured sentences with precise language. Maintain professionalism and avoid colloquialisms. Provide thorough explanations while remaining concise, as if addressing a board-level colleague.
stylePresets.coach: Respond as a coach and mentor. Instead of giving direct answers, ask guiding questions. Walk through reasoning step by step, helping discover insights independently.
stylePresets.professional: Respond like an experienced strategy consultant. Use the structure: situation → analysis → recommendation → next steps. Provide specific metrics and KPIs. Reference frameworks (SWOT, Porter, BCG matrix). Use precise business language with a clear action plan.
stylePresets.friendly: Respond warmly and casually, like a good friend. Use simple language, add emoji where they fit. Be supportive, enthusiastic, and positive. Keep it approachable but still helpful and on-point.

ai.anomalyCopy: Automatic detection of outliers in the KPI measurement series — via z-score (|z| > 2) and IQR (outside Q1−1.5·IQR / Q3+1.5·IQR). A point flagged by both methods or at |z| ≥ 3 is marked severe.
ai.anomalyServerNote: Anomalies are computed server-side (kpiAnomalyService engine) — results appear here once the KPI measurement endpoint is wired.
ai.forecastCopy: Linear regression (least squares) on each KPI's measurement history: value forecast, estimated time to target (ETA) and a leading alert when the trend misses target before the deadline.
ai.forecastConfidence: Confidence: low / medium / high (from measurement count + R² fit)
ai.forecastMinPoints: Requires min. 6 measurements per KPI. kpiForecastService engine — available after AI premium configuration.
ai.rcaCopy: For each KPI deviation a heuristic engine (no LLM, deterministic) generates root-cause hypotheses from signals: deviation, trend, adoption, data freshness, scope change, resource overload — and maps them to concrete corrective actions with an owner.
ai.rcaServerNote: Suggestions are computed server-side (deviationRcaSuggestService engine) — they appear here for detected deviations once the RCA endpoint is wired.
